notes: The groups are separate by design, so I left them unconnected. Page 2 shows the booklet building separate toys: (1) the ambulance, (2) the stretcher, (3) paramedic case 1, (4) paramedic case 2, (5) the street corner with traffic light, hydrant and bin, and (6) the bicycle. Nothing in the instructions fastens any of these to another.

The only links between them are loose placements: the stretcher is slid into the ambulance rear (b5-b22, free), the bin stands on the street plate (b168) and the helmet sits on the bike (b186). These are play positions, not fastenings. The two cases are carried by minifigures, which are not in the parts list, so they stay separate.
Minifigure parts (heads, hair, torsos, legs) shown on pages 4-5 are not in the supplied parts list, so they are not recorded.
Sticker sheet 98770 is recorded as one piece; sticker placements are not modelled.
Several rests_on relations (walls, roof, hood) were inferred from small isometric drawings and may differ in detail from the real build. Piece counts match the parts list exactly (187).
Bumper red plates b67/b68 are fitted under plate b69, so they are listed before it, and b69 rests on them.
Plates b162 and b163 of the street base are held together by the yellow tile b164 bridging them.
Positions are left null as required.
